original_record.question: Six points are marked on a sheet of squared paper as shown. Which of the following shapes cannot be made by connecting some of these points using straight lines? <image1>
options: all the shapes $\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{D}$ can be made
original_record.solution: The shape $R S U V$ is a parallelogram; $R S T U$ is a trapezium; $R S U$ is a right-angled triangle; $R S V$ is an obstuse-angled triangle.  Therefore all the shapes can be made.  ![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/2023_12_27_0f4ed2787981bb911326g-121.jpg?height=328&width=357&top_left_y=1315&top_left_x=1478)
